name: lightmap-night-floor-verify
description: LIGHTMAP-NIGHT-FLOOR: crossfade `visAnalytic * visNight` back to three's analytic fill as visDay falls, so a mapped shell surface is never darker than the unmapped furniture beside it. Phone viewport, realistic/weak, walk mode. Kitchen + living poses at 12:00 (control), 02:24 lights off (the defect hour), 06:00 lights off (the 'Morning' preset hour), and 02:24 lights on (the lamp-lit night arm).

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(12); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('off'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('weak'); s.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: A-pose-kitchen
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(6.8, 8.0); l.setYaw(-1.5708); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: A-pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: B-pose-kitchen
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(6.8, 8.0); l.setYaw(-1.5708); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: B-pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: B-probe
steps.eval: (() => { let mapped = 0; const nightVals = new Set(); const dayVals = new Set(); window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]; for (const m of ms) { if (!m || !m.userData || !m.userData.visDayUniform) continue; mapped++; dayVals.add(+m.userData.visDayUniform.value.toFixed(3)); if (m.userData.visNightUniform) nightVals.add(+m.userData.visNightUniform.value.toFixed(3)) } }); console.log('[probe] B mapped=' + mapped + ' visDay=' + JSON.stringify([...dayVals]) + ' visNight=' + JSON.stringify([...nightVals])) })()
